properties.name: Garni Temple
properties.description: Only surviving Greco-Roman colonnaded temple in the former Soviet Union. Dedicated to the sun god Mihr/Mithra. Overlooking a dramatic gorge.

properties.name: Mount Ararat (Ağrı Dağı)
properties.description: Armenia's national symbol though located in Turkey. Biblical landing place of Noah's Ark. Sacred mountain of Armenian identity.
properties.modernStatus: National park in Turkey, visible from Yerevan
